links.function: receiving raw light signals from the eyes and forming the initial visual image at the back of the brain
links.narration_bridge: First, light from both the basketball players and the gorilla reaches your visual cortex, the vision center at the back of your brain.

links.function: directing selective attention onto task-relevant targets while suppressing ignored visual signals
links.narration_bridge: Next, while counting white shirts, your parietal cortex locks its attention spotlight onto white shapes and blocks the dark gorilla signal.
